notes.content:
[h1]V1.12.9[/h1] 30/06/25
- Peacelands should perform better.
- Extension should no longer speed up RID crash.
- Nightmare mode now accessible upto wave 5 for all. Host can switch to nightmare at any time.
- Fixed false Double Gems.



[h1]V1.13[/h1]
- RID Crash should take substantially longer (Hoping a week plus, let me know)
- Added in !bot command;

[h2]How to use !bot[/h2]

Just use !bot and then the intended command after:
```!bot !spawn```

You will need to be a mod or above to use this command and the bot will be tied to the Host streamer, the bot has it's own stats as per-usual.

notes.title: Bits Extension V0.1.0
notes.content:
Hey,

I've created a [url=https://dashboard.twitch.tv/extensions/wulppddusj2rrix8dagmqdlh4cvzhv-0.1.0]Bits Extension[/url] upon suggestion. Viewers can currently use bits to activate 4 effects which the Streamer can set prices from within a range. 
[list]
[*] Double Gold x2 (15m)
[*] Double Gems x2 (15m)
[*] Force Nightmare Mode
[*] Spawn Skellington Blue
[/list]

The streamer won't be able to use it on their selves. It will not remove any bits from the Streamers. 80% of all Bits go to the Streamer and 20% to ChatTDT, you can find more info about this [url=https://help.twitch.tv/s/article/earning-revenue-from-bits-in-extensions?language=en_US]here[/url]!
Open to all feedback in the Discord or by e-mail!
support@ayrtonalexis.com

Also if you missed it! (below)
[url=store.steampowered.com/news/app/3060850/view/547857372725380706?snr=2___][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080388/f62e7e01f4c08880a4e56c75072f9558bdeaf703.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update 0.95 - Global Saving introduced!
notes.content:
[u][b]Global Saving is now here![/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080388/a380feaf2d517b6252097ce0d6a092634e3f8d38.png[/img]

Testing out users keeping their levels from stream to stream, [b]highly recommended not to play simultaneously in 2 different streams[/b].

You can toggle this in the main settings by switching Global Save to Local Save, plus vice versa.

Always appreciating feedback, especially in these early days!
Thanks again,
Ayrton
